items.item_text: Experience in a high-throughput service laboratory and the ability to generate results quickly and accurately

Under general supervision, serve in the Gel Analysis section of the Veterinary Genetics Lab, operating various molecular biology instruments to visualize genetic data generated by other sections of the service pipeline. There is no animal handling involved in this position. After training, manage data generation workflow across multiple platforms to ensure data are ready for the gel reader group. Trouble-shoot issues with the various visualization instruments as needed. This position may require working alone for a portion of the shift.
Skill to maintain focus while performing repetitive tasks (any line worker)
Ability to detect abnormal DNA fragment analysis results and technical expertise to establish a proper course of evaluation.
Skill to communicate effectively with laboratory personnel, students, and scientists both in written and oral form. (able to understand directions)
Skill to establish priorities and adapt to fluctuating workloads. (be flexible)
Skill to perform detailed procedures quickly and to accurately follow detailed protocols under minimal supervision. (can read something and do it)
Strict attention to detail and skill to operate precision electronic equipment, and computers quickly, safely and accurately. (have used machines to perform jobs)
